intent: Show that the monthly price of the Advair asthma inhaler is much higher in the United States than in six other developed countries.

requirements.question: How does the monthly Advair price in the United States compare with the six other countries?
Are all data marks declared by G0 present in the required state or states?

scope.selection: all data rows (table has no role column)

units.claim: The United States has the highest monthly Advair price at about $319, while every other listed country is below $83; even the closest comparison country is only about one-quarter of the U.S. price.
accept: the United States has the tallest bar and is the highest-priced country
the U.S. price is about $319 and every other country is below $83
the U.S. price is more than three times the highest comparison country and more than seven times the lowest
reject: saying another country has the highest price
treating the seven countries as five different drugs
omitting the United States or any comparison country
describing the U.S. price as only slightly higher than the others
units.evidence: Seven country bars share the same vertical dollar scale; the U.S. bar is much taller than all six comparison bars.

units.claim: All 7 required bar marks or stacked segments appear in the final chart.
accept: all 7 required data marks are visible
the complete required mark set is present in the final chart
reject: omitting any required bar or stacked segment
replacing missing marks with a summary total or subtitle
units.evidence: G0 data-row coverage is rendered as a complete set of identifiable bar marks.

optional_valid: The narration mentions five top-selling prescription drugs, but this chart shows only Advair across seven countries.

g0_data_completeness.selection: all data rows (table has no role column)
